2608.25910.title: SAMpLE: A SystemC-AMS Machine LEarning-based Framework for Virtual Prototyping
2608.25910.paper_summary: Machine Learning (ML) is increasingly used in virtual prototypes of embedded systems to model behaviors that are difficult to capture analytically. However, integrating ML models into virtual platform simulation is still typically done through ad hoc solutions, which limits reuse, comparability, and reproducibility. This paper presents \textbf{\textit{SAMpLE}}, an open-source SystemC-AMS-based framework that integrates ML models as first-class Timed Dataflow (TDF) components through a standardized plug-and-play interface. SAMpLE provides two execution backends: a native C++ backend for online training of lightweight models, and an offline backend for executing externally developed models without requiring re-implementation in C++ or manual integration steps. The framework uses ONNX as a standard model exchange format to enable integration of externally trained ML models into SystemC-AMS simulations, and allows the evaluation of different ML-based solutions within the same testbench, dataset, and simulation workflow. The modular design and unified and reproducible environment will allow future extensions of SAMpLE to new models, without modifying the SystemC-AMS structure.
2608.25910.paper_summary_zh: 機器學習（ML）越來越多地應用於嵌入式系統的虛擬原型中，以模擬難以用分析方法捕捉的行為。<lb/>然而，將 ML 模型整合到虛擬平台模擬中仍然通常是通過臨時解決方案來實現的，這限制了重用性、可比性和可重現性。<lb/>本文介紹了 \textbf{\textit{SAMpLE}}，一個基於 SystemC-AMS 的開源框架，通過標準化的即插即用接口將 ML 模型整合為一級的定時數據流（TDF）組件。<lb/>SAMpLE 提供了兩個執行後端：一個用於輕量級模型在線訓練的原生 C++ 後端，以及一個用於執行外部開發模型的離線後端，無需在 C++ 中重新實現或手動整合步驟。<lb/>該框架使用 ONNX 作為標準模型交換格式，以便將外部訓練的 ML 模型整合到 SystemC-AMS 模擬中，並允許在相同的測試平台、數據集和模擬工作流程中評估不同的基於 ML 的解決方案。<lb/>模組化設計和統一且可重現的環境將允許未來將 SAMpLE 擴展到新模型，而無需修改 SystemC-AMS 結構。
